name: ChaosBench S2S climate benchmark dataset
model_or_instrument: ChaosBench (with S2S ensemble forecasts from UKMO, NCEP, CMA, ECMWF and historical SST forcing)
resolution: 1.5° (121x240 grid), daily temporal resolution, 8 atmospheric variables/levels

scales.note: ChaosBench S2S atmospheric data spanning 1979-2023 (45 years) at daily resolution on a global 1.5 degree grid with 8 variables
